sport.title: Carlos Alcaraz’s full doubles record ahead of Spain vs Great Britain at the Davis Cup
paras: Carlos Alcaraz was selected to play doubles against Austria in the Davis Cup quarter-finals. Rested for singles, Alcaraz was ready to play alongside Marcel Granollers , but he wasn’t required to do so, as Daniel Merida and Rafael Jodar beat Joel Schwaerzler and Jurij Rodionov, respectively, to send Spain through to the semi-finals.

There, Alcaraz is expected to return to singles action to play Arthur Fery, although he could still play doubles if needed against the new British duo of Henry Patten and Neal Skupski . With Alcaraz prepared for doubles action in Bologna, we thought now was the right time to assess his record in the discipline… Alcaraz is 327-70 in singles action, winning 82.37% of his matches, but how does his doubles record compare?

sport.title: All 13 players who have beaten Alexander Zverev in 2026 as his best-ever season ends
paras: Alexander Zverev has officially seen the best season of his tennis career so far come to an end. Zverev beat Britain’s Arthur Fery 6-3, 6-2, but this was not enough to keep Germany in the Davis Cup Finals after their defeat in the deciding doubles match.

This has officially ended Zverev’s 2026 season, which has seen him win his first two Grand Slam titles and become world number one, as he took advantage of injuries to both Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner this year. While Zverev has found great success at Grand Slam tournaments, his victories at Roland Garros and the US Open were the only two titles he has won this year, having lost 19 matches to 13 different players.

sport.title: Swiss ATP player reveals what Roger Federer was really like to practice with
paras: When Dylan Dietrich was 16, his coach said he had a new practice partner. It was Roger Federer, a famous Swiss tennis player. Dylan felt so nervous that he arrived an hour early to warm up. Federer walked over, shook his hand, and introduced himself. Dylan already knew who he was, but still loved the moment.

Years later, Dylan said Federer made him feel good about his tennis, even though Federer’s low, sliding shots were hard to return. Dylan is now a 22-year-old tennis player who has won two Challenger titles. He has climbed to world number 155. Federer inspired him, and Dylan’s story shows how a kind moment can stay with someone for years.

sport.title: Flavio Cobolli makes comment about the conditions at the Davis Cup after losing again
paras: Flavio Cobolli lost to Jiri Lehecka, 2-6, 6-1, 3-6, in the Davis Cup semi-finals. The Italian number two had a chance to send his side into the Davis Cup final after Lorenzo Musetti beat Jakub Mensik in the first singles match. He was no match for Lehecka in the end, though, suffering a three-set defeat against the Czech.

He has been beaten twice at the Davis Cup Finals on home turf. Cobolli lost to Soonwoo Kwon earlier in the week and has now lost to Lehecka. During his post-match press conference, the 24-year-old shared his verdict on the conditions in Bologna.

sport.title: The three world number ones with a worse win ratio than Alexander Zverev’s in 2026
paras: Alexander Zverev might just be one of the most criticised and debated world number ones in tennis history. The German, who officially ascended to the apex of the ATP Tour during the US Open earlier this year, did so in the absence of both Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner.

Both have suffered huge injuries which kept them out for months on end, with the Italian playing his last match of 2026 in the Wimbledon final in July. It’s been a truly unthinkable year for the men’s game, and many see Alexander Zverev as the embodiment of such a lack of all-around quality and competition.

paras: Andreeva won the WTA Finals at the end of the 2026 season, enabling her to overtake Aryna Sabalenka by ending the year as the world number two, only behind Elena Rybakina .

The 19-year-old has enjoyed the best year of her career in 2026, with Andreeva also becoming a Grand Slam champion for the first time after winning Roland Garros in June, as well as winning WTA titles in Adelaide and Linz.
